mathematical_claims.anchor: The local Artin conductor exponent is the sum, over i from zero onward, of the codimension of the vectors fixed by G sub i, multiplied by the size of G sub i divided by the size of G zero.
Thus the Artin conductor is the tame contribution plus the Swan conductor.
the conductor of the direct sum is the sum of the two conductors.
for a ramified one-dimensional character, the conductor exponent is one plus its final upper ramification break.
